title: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Uttar Pradesh state expansion pathway for government-funded health assurance for eligible households outside or alongside PM-JAY beneficiary groups.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current UP state beneficiary categories and notified household criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Abhiyan.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
